displayName: Sample: TRUMPF TruLaser of the TRUMPF OPC UA simulator, definition L26

elements.evidence: TrumpfMachine/2:Identification/2:SerialNumber. Its value is the machine id of every topic.

Derived: the server has no MachineryItemState building block. Taken from 5:Production/5:ActiveProgram/5:State/CurrentState/Number (OPC 40501-1 ProductionStateMachine: 1 = Running), every other state is NotExecuting. OutOfService and NotAvailable cannot be told.

Derived: the server has no MachineryOperationMode building block. Taken from 5:Monitoring/5:MachineTool/5:OperationMode (MachineOperationMode: 0 Manual, 1 Automatic, 2 Setup, 3 AutoWithManualIntervention, 4 Service, 5 Other). Manual and Other say nothing about the purpose and give None, as the data model asks for an unknown mode.
The MachineTool instance has no OperationCounters. Taken from the TRUMPF interface, ActivityMeters/PowerOnTime, a Double in hours (17988.68 at the scan); hours times 3600.
5:Monitoring/5:MachineTool/5:FeedOverride, AnalogUnitRange with EURange 0..100: percent, so times 0.01.

TRUMPF interface, Machine/EnergyMetering/InstantaneousValues/Power/PowerTotal. The node has no EngineeringUnits; the simulator documents kilowatt; times 1000. Unclear until a person confirms the unit of the real meter.

TRUMPF interface, Machine/EnergyMetering/MeterReadings/Energy/ReceivedEnergy. The node has no EngineeringUnits; the simulator documents kilowatt hours; times 1000 for wattHour, the unit of the catalogue of the data model. Unclear until a person confirms the unit of the real meter.
TRUMPF interface, ActivityMeters/DrivesOnTime, hours. The data model has no such element, so it is a value of the maker.
